verdict.rationale: Vercel's Marketplace is described as "a collection of first-party services you can easily add to your Vercel project," with a Database category and listings like Neon Postgres and Pinecone. Per-environment variable management and AI Gateway's centralized credentials suggest a lighter path than hand-wiring. However, nothing documents native bindings or automatic credential injection into code, and a community report says secure database connections beyond a password require an enterprise sales contact. missing for 10: documented native binding API or auto-injected connection credentials, first-party storage or blob primitives, evidence of minimal-boilerplate code wiring, hands-on corroboration.
